title: UsageMeasurement
description: One usage report for one call (docs/design/m0/05 "Usage and settlement" [M7]). Outputs are fenced; accounting is not: reports are accepted from any attempt, stale or not. internal/capacity/ledger reconciles them: deltas deduplicated by (call, sequence), a final replaces their sum only when not lower, and only a provider_reconciliation can lower a figure.

call.description: The call-ledger id, recorded in the call's intent (03 effects).

sequence.description: Per call: deltas are numbered from 0; a final or reconciliation also carries one, so a later report of the same kind supersedes an earlier.

source_of_truth.description: gateway_count and gateway_floor are the gateway's own count of one request it sent (P11b), kept apart from the adapter's reports: gateway_floor recorded before the request is sent, gateway_count after its response is forwarded whole with its usage read, superseding the floor at the same sequence. An adapter's final settles a call only when no request of it has a floor alone and the final is not below the counts.
